title: Agent4RE: A Self-Refining Multi-agent Framework for End-to-End Software Requirements Engineering and Benchmarking
title_zh: Agent4RE：一种用于端到端软件需求工程与基准测试的自我优化多智能体框架

paragraphs.en: Existing LLM-based approaches for software Requirements Engineering (RE) typically rely on basic prompting strategies or rudimentary agent collaboration, under-utilizing the full potential of multi-agent systems. Meanwhile, available datasets focus on isolated subtasks, such as requirements extraction, classification, and completeness detection, leaving the absence of an end-to-end RE benchmark that spans from requirements elicitation to generation. We present Agent4RE -- a self-refining multi-agent RE system that orchestrates specialized agents and incorporates two iterative improvement loops. To support evaluation, we construct RE-E2E 1 1 1 We provide RE-E2E benchmark dataset, Agent4RE source code, and supplementary materials at https://github.com/markustyj/Agent4RE_ASE-2026 . – a real-world dataset built from human-written requirement specifications, enabling end-to-end assessment of RE workflows. Building on this foundation, we further propose two enhanced Agent4RE versions that incorporate either autonomous self-refinement or structured human feedback, and analyze their strengths and limitations across different scenarios. Evaluation on 8 Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrates that all three Agent4RE variants consistently outperform a domain-context-augmented prompting baseline by average 8% in text-based metrics. The two enhanced variants achieve the highest LLM-as-a-judge and human ratings, surpassing two RE baselines by approximately 0.8 points on a four-point scale. This consistent performance establishes Agent4RE as a practical end-to-end RE solution for industrial environments.

paragraphs.en: Requirements Engineering (RE) serves as a preliminary stage in software development, establishing a shared understanding of stakeholders’ needs, goals, and constraints while providing the foundation for subsequent software design, implementation, and verification ( Laplante and Kassab, 2022 ) . Traditionally, this process has required substantial effort from multiple roles – developers, business analysts, domain experts, and project managers – who must iteratively perform elicitation, analysis, specification, and validation together to produce complete, consistent, and clear requirement documentation ( Nuseibeh and Easterbrook, 2000 ) . Given this labor-intensive nature and the fact that defects originating from this phase are significantly more expensive to fix in later stages, improvements in RE efficiency and quality can yield substantial benefits across the entire software development lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 需求工程（RE）是软件开发中的一个初步阶段，旨在建立对利益相关者需求、目标和约束的共同理解，并为后续的软件设计、实现和验证奠定基础（Laplante 和 Kassab，2022）。 传统上，这一过程需要开发人员、业务分析师、领域专家和项目管理者等多个角色投入大量精力，他们必须通过迭代的方式共同完成需求提取、分析、规格定义和验证，以生成完整、一致且清晰的需求文档（Nuseibeh 和 Easterbrook，2000）。 鉴于这一过程劳动密集型的特点，以及源于该阶段的问题在后续阶段修复成本显著更高的事实，提升需求工程的效率和质量可以在整个软件开发生命周期中带来巨大的收益。

paragraphs.en: Recently, advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for requirements engineering ( Ferrari and Spoletini, 2025 ) . With superior capabilities in domain knowledge inference, natural language understanding, and ambiguity detection, LLMs are well suited to accelerate and assist diverse RE sub-tasks, such as extracting requirements from unstructured inputs, identifying inconsistencies in RE specifications, and generating documentation based on stakeholder instructions ( Zadenoori et al., 2025 ) . However, existing studies predominately focus on such isolated RE sub-tasks, achieving success only on individual activities, yet offering limited support for the complex, interconnected requirements engineering processes in real-world scenarios. While recent efforts have explored LLM-based interactive systems and agents to aggregate these isolated capabilities ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , no systematic end-to-end solution has been proposed and evaluated for the full RE lifecycle. Similarly, this fragmentation extends to data resources: accessible datasets are limited to separate RE tasks and no comprehensive open-source benchmark has been released to assess the entire requirements engineering process.
paragraphs.zh: 近期，大型语言模型（LLM）的进步为需求工程开辟了新的途径（Ferrari 和 Spoletini，2025）。 LLM 在领域知识推理、自然语言理解和歧义检测方面具备卓越能力，因此非常适合加速并协助各种需求工程子任务，例如从非结构化输入中提取需求、识别需求规格中的不一致性，以及根据利益相关者的指示生成文档（Zadenoori 等人，2025）。 然而，现有研究主要关注此类孤立的需求工程子任务，仅能在单个活动中取得成功，但对真实场景中复杂且相互关联的需求工程流程提供的支持有限。 尽管近期的研究已探索基于 LLM 的交互式系统和智能体以整合这些孤立的能力（Tang 等人，2026），但尚未有人提出并评估过覆盖完整需求工程生命周期的系统性端到端解决方案。 同样，这种碎片化也延伸至数据资源：可用的数据集仅限于单独的需求工程任务，且尚未发布任何全面的开源基准来评估整个需求工程流程。

paragraphs.en: Extensive language model-based approaches have been proposed for diverse stages throughout the requirements engineering cycle. Building on the early transformer architecture ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , researchers fine-tuned BERT to detect anaphoric ambiguity in requirements and evaluated it against traditional supervised entity recognition techniques ( Ezzini et al., 2022 ) . A similar approach was introduced to identify intra-domain ambiguities in the requirements of interdisciplinary projects ( Moharil and Sharma, 2023 ) . Given BERT’s encoder-based architecture, parallel studies trained specialized BERT variants for requirements classification, achieving improved accuracy over machine learning techniques like decision trees and support vector machines ( Hey et al., 2020 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) . As language models have scaled up, strategic few-shot prompting has emerged as a more streamlined solution to requirements classification, delivering on-par performance with fine-tuned models while eliminating the computational overhead of training ( El-Hajjami et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 针对需求工程周期中各个不同阶段，已有大量基于语言模型的方法被提出。 在早期 Transformer 架构（Vaswani 等人，2017）的基础上，研究人员对 BERT 进行了微调，以检测需求中的指代歧义，并将其与传统监督式实体识别技术（Ezzini 等人，2022）进行了对比评估。 一种类似的方法也被引入，用于识别跨学科项目需求中的域内歧义（Moharil 和 Sharma，2023）。 鉴于 BERT 的编码器架构，多项并行研究训练了专门用于需求分类的 BERT 变体，其准确率优于决策树和支持向量机等机器学习技术（Hey 等人，2020；Luo 等人，2023）。 随着语言模型规模的扩大，策略性的少样本提示已成为需求分类的一种更简洁的解决方案，其性能可与微调模型相媲美，同时避免了训练带来的计算开销（El-Hajjami 等人，2023；Tang 等人，2024；Tang 等人，2025）。

sents.zh: 随着语言模型规模的扩大，策略性的少样本提示已成为需求分类的一种更简洁的解决方案，其性能可与微调模型相媲美，同时避免了训练带来的计算开销（El-Hajjami 等人，2023；Tang 等人，2024；Tang 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: The superior reasoning capabilities of these large-scale models enable effective requirements analysis while their generative nature aligns with the needs for requirements elicitation and specification generation. Given this potential, a preliminary evaluation ( Arora et al., 2024 ) explored the role of LLMs across different RE stages and suggested tailored prompt patterns for elicitation, analysis, specification, and validation tasks. Building on this foundation, LLMREI ( Korn et al., 2025 ) employs LLMs as automated interviewers within a chatbot to simulate the requirements elicitation process with human stakeholders, designed to minimize human intervention and mitigate common interview-related errors. SpecGen ( Ma et al., 2025 ) leveraged a two-phase prompting approach to generate precise behavioral comments for program-level specifications, while ReqGPT ( Schiller et al., 2025 ) , a 7B-parameter domain-specific LLM fine-tuned on over one hundred curated requirement lists, was developed to improve specification quality. Despite these breakthroughs in specific RE aspects, existing methods still fall short in delivering complete requirement specifications for production environments, indicating the need for more robust and comprehensive approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 这些大规模模型卓越的推理能力使其能够进行有效的需求分析，而其生成特性则契合了需求挖掘和规格生成的需求。 鉴于这一潜力，一项初步评估（Arora 等人，2024）探讨了大型语言模型在不同需求工程阶段的作用，并为需求挖掘、分析、规格生成和验证任务提出了定制化的提示模式。 在此基础上，LLMREI（Korn 等人，2025）将大型语言模型用作聊天机器人中的自动化访谈者，模拟与人类利益相关者进行需求挖掘的过程，旨在最大限度地减少人工干预并减轻常见的访谈相关错误。 SpecGen（Ma 等人，2025）采用两阶段提示方法生成程序级规格的精确行为描述，而 ReqGPT（Schiller 等人，2025）则是一款经过优化、在超过一百份精选需求列表上微调的 7B 参数领域专用大型语言模型，旨在提升规格质量。 尽管在这些特定的需求工程方面取得了突破，现有方法仍无法为生产环境提供完整的需求规格，这表明需要更稳健、更全面的方法。

paragraphs.en: The collaborative workflow of multi-agent systems offers a promising paradigm to tackle more complex end-to-end RE challenges ( Tang and Runkler, 2026 ) . As an early exploration ( Sami et al., 2024 ) , researchers implemented an LLM-based agentic system with GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 to automate user story elicitation, requirements generation, and prioritization for agile software projects. Extending this prior work, a subsequent study proposed a role-based multi-agent system that emulates stakeholder roles to collaboratively generate and prioritize requirements from project descriptions ( Sami et al., 2026 ) . Another modular architecture ReqInOne breaks down requirements generation into three sub-tasks: summary, extraction, and classification ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , using tailored prompt templates to improve the quality and consistency of LLM outputs. In comparison, Elicitron has focused on more specific RE activities ( Ataei et al., 2024 ) . The system simulates elicitation interviews to explore product experiences and identify stakeholders’ needs, thus enabling the discovery of unforeseen use cases through structured LLM interactions. Moving toward end-to-end automation, iReDev ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , previously also called MARE ( Jin et al., 2024 ) , represents a knowledge-driven multi-agent framework designed to address the full requirements engineering process. It incorporates human expert knowledge into six agents via chain-of-thought prompting and structured reasoning, enabling them to manage an event-driven artifact pool collaboratively. Nevertheless, due to the absence of resources for end-to-end RE assessment, the evaluation focused primarily on intermediate steps such as requirements modeling and entity extraction. The final specifications were evaluated only through subjective metrics such as completeness, correctness, and consistency.

paragraphs.en: Our multi-agent system offers three different versions, each with distinct advantages: 1) a sequential workflow without feedback for streamlined RE processes; 2) a workflow with self-refinement that enables the system to iteratively improve the outputs; 3) a workflow with human feedback that incorporates domain experts to guide the refinement process.

paragraphs.en: With the detailed report, the requirements generation agent A G A_{G} produces the initial specification document: D 0 = A G ​ ( R , T r ​ e ) D_{0}=A_{G}(R,T_{re}) . To ensure structural compliance, the required specification templates T r ​ e T_{re} ( Standard, 1998 ; Standard, 2018 ) are integrated into LLMs’ system message as a reference, steering the agent to strictly follow the structure. Due to the document length, the generation time typically ranges from a few seconds to over one minute, depending on the model size and inference configuration. Once finished, the generated specification is returned to the orchestrator for validation, which verifies the document before handing over to human users. paragraphs.en: Existing data resources for RE predominantly focus on individual stages, suffering from several limitations: incomplete coverage, poor community visibility, and limited support for end-to-end evaluation ( Motger et al., 2025 ) . For instance, PROMISE ( Li et al., 2014 ) , a requirements classification benchmark extensively used in prior work, contains only isolated requirement items. Similarly, PURE ( Ferrari et al., 2017 ) provides requirement specification documents for various software systems, but lacks a unified structural template for standardized processing and systematic evaluation. And a more recent RE dataset ( Bragilovski et al., 2024 ) provides a collection of user stories pairing with the corresponding domain models, yet it still excludes complete requirement specifications. As LLM capabilities and agentic workflows advance continuously, the ambition within the research community and industry has grown beyond addressing isolated RE tasks toward autonomous management of the entire RE lifecycle. Addressing data scarcity has become an urgent priority to enable the exploration of end-to-end agentic solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的需求工程（RE）数据资源主要聚焦于单个阶段，并存在若干局限性：覆盖不完整、社区可见性差以及对端到端评估的支持有限（Motger 等人，2025）。 例如，PROMISE（Li 等人，2014）是一个在前人研究中广泛使用的需求分类基准数据集，但它仅包含孤立的需求条目。 类似地，PURE（Ferrari 等人，2017）提供了多种软件系统的需求规格文档，但缺乏用于标准化处理和系统性评估的统一结构模板。 而一个较新的需求工程数据集（Bragilovski 等人，2024）提供了一系列与对应领域模型配对的用户故事，但仍然不包含完整的需求规格说明。 随着大语言模型（LLM）的能力与智能体工作流持续进步，研究界和工业界的愿景已从解决孤立的需求工程任务，转向对完整需求工程生命周期进行自主管理。 解决数据稀缺问题已成为当务之急，以推动对端到端智能体解决方案的探索。

paragraphs.en: Based on the original specification template used by developers, we divide the collected PDF files into two sets: one adhering to IEEE 830 ( Standard, 1998 ) , which defines the structure for traditional software requirements specifications, and another following IEEE 29148 ( Standard, 2018 ) , an updated standard that incorporates systems and software engineering requirements with more modern practices. Specifically, we use regular expressions ( Friedl, 2006 ) to clean noise such as unexpected newline characters and consecutive spaces, obtaining normalized plain text. However, in some edge cases, the original section names of human-written specifications do not strictly follow the IEEE format. To create a dataset with unified structure, we match these sections with the official IEEE section names based on their semantic embeddings. To ensure dataset reproducibility, we use the open-source Qwen3-embedding-8B to match RE-sections. If the cosine similarity between two sections falls below 0.7, human annotators must intervene. They review each section independently and reach consensus on whether to remove or retain it as empty. The cross-annotator agreement is 96.7%, meaning that all annotators make the same binary decision in most cases. For the remaining 3.3%, annotators follow majority vote. In Table 4 , we record the section empty rates.

paragraphs.en: Our experiments involve eight LLMs spanning different performance tiers to investigate the full potential of our agentic framework. We deploy four frontier models via APIs, including GPT-5 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) , GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025b ) , GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) , and Gemini-3-flash ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , which represent the forefront of LLM capabilities. To complement these proprietary models, we incorporate four open-source alternatives that ensure reproducibility and broader applicability: LLaMA3.1-8B from Meta AI ( Dubey et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-8B from Alibaba ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Ministral3-8B from Mistral ( MistralAI, 2025 ) , and Gemma4-4B from Google ( Deepmind, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: To compare the generated requirement specifications with the ground-truth in RE-E2E, we employ an extensive set of evaluation approaches, including text-based metrics, semantic-based metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluators.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将生成的需求规格与 RE-E2E 中的真实参考数据进行比较，我们采用了一系列全面的评估方法，包括基于文本的指标、基于语义的指标、将大型语言模型用作评判者以及人类评估员。

paragraphs.en: Regarding text-based metrics, we apply METEOR ( Banerjee and Lavie, 2005 ) , BLEU-1 ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) , and ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) . METEOR evaluates text similarity through a harmonic mean of precision and recall, incorporating stemming, synonymy, and word order penalties. BLEU-1 measures the proportion of individual words (unigrams) in the generated text that match the reference text, while ROUGE-L evaluates the longest common subsequence between the candidate and reference texts.
paragraphs.zh: 关于文本指标，我们采用了 METEOR（Banerjee 和 Lavie，2005）、BLEU-1（Papineni 等，2002）以及 ROUGE-L（Lin，2004）。 METEOR 通过精确率和召回率的调和平均值来评估文本相似性，同时考虑了词干提取、同义词替换和词序惩罚等因素。 BLEU-1 衡量生成文本中与参考文本匹配的单个词语（一元项）的比例，而 ROUGE-L 则评估候选文本与参考文本之间的最长公共子序列。

paragraphs.en: For semantic-based metrics, we apply BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2019 ) and SentenceBert ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) . BERTScore computes token-level semantic similarity by comparing BERT-based word embeddings between the candidate and reference texts, while SentenceBert measures sentence-level similarity by encoding texts into dense vector representations and calculating their cosine similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于语义的指标，我们应用了 BERTScore（Zhang 等人，2019）和 SentenceBert（Reimers 和 Gurevych，2019）。 BERTScore 通过比较候选文本和参考文本之间基于 BERT 的词嵌入来计算词元级别的语义相似度，而 SentenceBert 则通过将文本编码为密集向量表示并计算它们的余弦相似度来衡量句子级别的相似度。

paragraphs.en: LLM-as-a-judge leverages prompt-based assessment to grade the generated requirement specifications. Figure 4 presents the prompt template used for this approach, with grades assigned on a scale from 1 to 4. To assess RE quality in practice, developers typically require a language checker for ambiguity, an app-lifecycle tool for completeness, and a formal/model checker for logical consistency, leading to increased toolchain complexity. Since these quality criteria are fundamentally grounded in written text and requirements, LLMs are natural requirements evaluators given their expertise in language processing. However, this suitability does not apply to all model scales. While large-scale models demonstrate promising capabilities in judging text quality, compact models often struggle ( Gu et al., ) – even the best one misjudges. Therefore, we deploy this evaluation strategy exclusively to four top-tier models (GPT-5, GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, and Gemini-3-flash).
paragraphs.zh: LLM-as-a-judge 利用基于提示词的评估方法，对生成的需求规格进行评分。 图 4 展示了该方法所使用的提示词模板，评分采用 1 到 4 分的等级制。 在实际中评估 RE 质量时，开发人员通常需要语言检查器来检测歧义、应用生命周期工具来确保完整性，以及形式化/模型检查器来验证逻辑一致性，这会导致工具链的复杂性增加。 由于这些质量标准本质上基于书面文本和需求，而 LLM 在语言处理方面具备专业优势，因此它们天然适合作为需求评估者。 然而，这种适用性并非适用于所有规模的模型。 虽然大规模模型在判断文本质量方面展现出令人期待的潜力，但紧凑型模型往往难以胜任（Gu et al.,）——即便是表现最佳的模型也会出现误判。 因此，我们将这一评估策略专门应用于四个顶级模型（GPT-5、GPT-4.1、GPT-4o 和 Gemini-3-flash）。

paragraphs.en: We further include human evaluation for comparison. To align with LLM-as-a-judge, three software developers from industry assess summaries independently on a scale from 1 to 4, with final scores averaged for fairness. We select human evaluators based on their software development experience and RE domain expertise. Finally, we choose three senior software engineers, each with two to three years of development experience in industry. In addition to their own judgment criteria, we also provide them with the prompt and grading schema used in LLM-as-a-judge to ensure consistent evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Since iterative human feedback has no theoretical upper limit on performance, we perform one optimization loop for all Agent4RE variants to ensure fair comparison. Table 5 demonstrates the evaluation results for end-to-end specification generation in the next page. Agent4RE significantly outperforms the two baselines in most considered metrics, with each variant exhibiting superior performance in different evaluation dimensions. For traditional text- and semantic-based metrics, incorporating high-level feedback from human developers yields the best results, achieving 0.251 in METEOR, 0.273 in Rouge-L, 0.063 in BLEU-1, 0.838 in BERT F1 score, and 0.392 in Sentence-BERT similarity. As for LLM-as-a-judge, pure self-refinement with GPT-5 slightly outperforms the human-in-the-loop variant, with both GPT-5 and GPT-4.1 models securing perfect 4.0 ratings when evaluated by GPT-4.1. However, upon human evaluation, self-refinement with human feedback still performs best, scoring the highest 3.29 out of 4. In comparison, the two baselines fall short, reaching 2.22 and 2.87 respectively in human evaluation.

paragraphs.en: If we zoom in model performance for detailed analysis, three GPT models lead the performance in most metrics, especially when deployed within the sequential workflow without feedback or self-refinement with human feedback. Among them, the latest GPT-5 model demonstrates exceptional performance in LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation, achieving near-perfect scores from other LLM evaluators when integrated into the Agent4RE framework. However, an unexpected finding emerges with pure self-refinement: iterative improvement loops lead to degraded performance on semantic-based metrics, as evidenced by Sentence BERT. This phenomenon may stem from LLMs’ deliberate attempts to modify content, and such purposeful revisions can result in substantial semantic drift. We provide a case study in the supplementary materials, including an example of software project description, human feedback, and the generated requirement specifications. Due to the length of the generated content, a separate JSON file recording the output of each agent throughout the complete agentic workflow is included in the uploaded repository.

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 5 , all three Agent4RE variants outperform the two baselines. Self-refinement with human feedback achieves the best average score across all four metrics. Compared to the prompting baseline, this variant achieves approximately 4% improvements in METEOR and an average of 0.8 points in human and LLM evaluation. However, we notice a dip in performance in the lower bound of pure self-refinement, particularly in METEOR and BERTScore, which indicates that less capable language models struggle to support iterative self-improvement, and a minimum threshold of model capacity is required to make self-refinement strategies effective. Furthermore, an upward trend is observed from left to right, reflecting the progressive advancements in three key dimensions: from basic prompting strategies to more complicated agentic approaches, from linear workflows to iterative self-refined loops, and from model-only generation to human-guided collaborative systems.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 5 所示，所有三种 Agent4RE 变体都优于两种基线模型。 结合人类反馈的自我优化在所有四项指标中取得了最佳平均得分。 与提示词基线相比，该变体在 METEOR 指标上提升了约 4%，在人类和 LLM 评估中平均提升了 0.8 分。 然而，我们注意到纯自我优化在下限范围内的性能有所下降，尤其是在 METEOR 和 BERTScore 指标上，这表明能力较弱的语言模型难以支持迭代式自我改进，因此需要达到一个最低模型容量阈值，才能使自我优化策略有效。 此外，从左到右呈现出上升趋势，反映了三个关键维度的逐步进步：从基础的提示词策略到更复杂的智能体方法，从线性工作流程到迭代的自我优化循环，以及从仅依赖模型的生成到人引导的协作系统。

paragraphs.en: The proposed Agent4RE framework significantly outperforms existing baselines on the newly released RE-E2E dataset, leveraging five collaborative self-refining agents. While the pure self-refinement variant strengthens the basic sequential workflow, it requires sufficient model capacity to be effective. After multiple iterative improvement loops, less capable models may struggle and produce content with substantial semantic drift. In comparison, strategically incorporating human expertise at critical decision point proves to be beneficial for the agentic system, guiding them toward desired quality and generating consistent RE specifications. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of self-refinement loops for each LLM. The results reveal that model stability, i.e. lower variance across iterations, serves as a stronger performance indicator than the total number of executed iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的 Agent4RE 框架在新发布的 RE-E2E 数据集上显著优于现有基线模型，这得益于五个协同自优化的智能体。 虽然纯自优化变体增强了基本的顺序工作流程，但其有效性需要模型具备足够的容量。 经过多次迭代改进循环后，能力较弱的模型可能会遇到困难，并生成存在严重语义偏移的内容。 相比之下，在关键决策点策略性地引入人类专业知识对智能体系统大有裨益，能够引导其达到预期质量并生成一致的 RE 规范。 此外，我们还分析了自优化循环对每个 LLM 的影响。 结果表明，模型稳定性（即迭代过程中的方差较低）比总迭代次数更能准确反映性能水平。

paragraphs.en: This work opens several promising avenues for future research. Building on Agent4RE, we encourage exploring alternative self-refining architectures, incorporating specialized agents to optimize the performance. Moreover, as LLMs continue to evolve, benchmarking new models within this agentic framework will provide valuable insights into how model capability enhancement translates to improved specification generation performance. Beyond RE-E2E, the research community also requires more end-to-end benchmarks that involve structured RE specification annotations. While our dataset uses well-formed project descriptions to establish a controlled baseline, real-world briefs could be ambiguous. To better reflect such settings, future work could introduce a stress-test subset with ambiguous briefs to assess their impact on evaluation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作为未来研究开辟了若干充满前景的方向。 在 Agent4RE 的基础上，我们鼓励探索替代性的自我优化架构，并引入专门智能体以优化性能。 此外，随着大语言模型持续演进，在此智能体框架内对新模型进行基准测试，将有助于深入理解模型能力的提升如何转化为更优的规范生成性能。 除了 RE-E2E 之外，研究界还需要更多涉及结构化 RE 规范标注的端到端基准测试。 尽管我们的数据集使用格式规范的项目描述来建立受控的基线，但现实中的需求说明可能存在歧义。 为了更好地反映此类场景，未来研究可以引入一个包含模糊需求说明的压力测试子集，以评估其对评估质量的影响。
